newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague to raise capital for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Somague to raise capital for acquisition.

text.p: Portuguese civil engineering group Somague will raise its capital by five billion escudos and issue 3.5 billion escudos of debt to finance its purchase of building company Assiconstroi from A.Silva & Silva, a spokesman said.
"Somague will carry out a capital increase to bring in five billion escudos and issue medium and long term debt of 3.5 billion escudos," Somague vice-president Diogo Vaz Guedes told Reuters.
He said the value of the deal was 8.25 billion escudos.
He could not estimate the price of the operation to raise capital.
Vaz Guedes said the purchase would allow Somague to to boost its civil construction and international activities.
